name: Saying I Love You
overview: Scripture reveals that love is both a divine gift and a committed action, demonstrated in our relationship with God and with others. The Lord expresses His love by valuing and protecting His people, as seen in Isaiah’s assurance of honor and deliverance for those He loves. Likewise, believers respond with devotion and trust, declaring their love for God because He hears their prayers and delivers them from enemies. In human relationships, love calls for unity and faithfulness, exemplified by the marital bond where a man cleaves to his wife to become one flesh, while honest communication, even rebuke, is a truer expression of love than hidden affection.
